name: @game-hub/kernel
description: The Game Hub kernel: the tiny set of primitives every game and both hosts share — GameError, MoveRecord, Viewer, record(), makeSeating, the end-state union, and the GameModule/GameClient contracts. Consumed as TypeScript source by subpath (the engine convention). This package MAY have a `.` entry — it's the kernel, not a per-game platform, so there is no ambiguity about a default.
